topic: Interior Lighting Sub System (Z-ONE-3.0 Platform - IBD10)
row_semantics: Each row represents a specific command or control signal for the right-hand side (RH) ambient lighting system, detailing its input source, associated controller/module, and the meaning of the command value.

column_semantics.Input: The source of the signal (e.g., LIN bus, LHZCU module).
column_semantics.LHZCU: Signal from the Local Zone Control Unit.
column_semantics.CnsoAmbtLampB_RH: Specific command for the right-hand ambient lamp.

core_entities.name: CnsoRHBLampOnOff_1
core_entities.description: Turns the RH ambient lamp ON or OFF.

core_entities.name: CnsoRHBLampColorCmd_1
core_entities.description: Sets the color of the RH ambient lamp.

core_entities.name: CnsoRHBLampBrtnsCmd_1
core_entities.description: Adjusts the brightness of the RH ambient lamp.

core_entities.name: CnsoRHBLampBrthngCmd_1
core_entities.description: Configures the breathing rate of the RH ambient lamp.

core_conditions.name: 灯光切换为色坐标对应的颜色
core_conditions.description: When the color command is set to 0 or an undefined color code, the light maintains its current color.

core_conditions.name: 指令值为0时保持亮度不变
core_conditions.description: If the brightness command is 0x00, the light maintains its current brightness.

core_outputs.name: 灯光亮度调节到相应的百分比值
core_outputs.description: The brightness command adjusts the lamp's brightness to a corresponding percentage value.

core_outputs.name: 新增(0-100%跳变)
core_outputs.description: The breathing rate command introduces a new mode where the brightness changes between 0% and 100%.

core_timing_constraints.name: Rate1
core_timing_constraints.description: The breathing rate is set to 500ms when the command is Rate1.

engineering_interpretation: This table defines the control signals and their meanings for the RH ambient lighting system, including commands for turning the light on/off, setting color, adjusting brightness, and configuring breathing rates. It can be used to verify that the lighting system correctly interprets and responds to these commands under various conditions.
uncertain_points: The exact behavior of the system when receiving undefined color codes is not fully specified.
